Aang.inscription: 乘风越山海，以慈悲护众生
Aang.inscriptionEnglish: Across mountains and seas he rides the wind, protecting all life with compassion.

Appa.inscription: 六足踏云，万里不忘归人
Appa.inscriptionEnglish: Six feet tread the clouds; across ten thousand miles, he never forgets his family.

Aunt Wu.inscription: 仰看云卷舒，笑谈人间缘
Aunt Wu.inscriptionEnglish: She watches the clouds unfurl and speaks with a smile of earthly fortunes.

Azula.inscription: 蓝焰照王座，雷光映孤心
Azula.inscriptionEnglish: Blue fire lights the throne; lightning reveals a lonely heart.

Bato.inscription: 同舟经风浪，旧誓系归航
Bato.inscriptionEnglish: Through storms in the same boat, old promises guide the journey home.

Cabbage Merchant.inscription: 几番青蔬散，明朝又满车
Cabbage Merchant.inscriptionEnglish: His cabbages scatter time and again; tomorrow, his cart will be full once more.

Chit Sang.inscription: 铁壁囚其身，烈火不囚志
Chit Sang.inscriptionEnglish: Iron walls may hold his body, but no fire can imprison his will.

Chong.inscription: 一曲穿山去，笑声伴旅人
Chong.inscriptionEnglish: A song winds through the mountains, carrying laughter to fellow travelers.

Combustion Man.inscription: 独目凝无声，一念山石裂
Combustion Man.inscriptionEnglish: His lone eye gathers silence; a single thought shatters stone.

Guru Pathik.inscription: 心结随水解，万物本同流
Guru Pathik.inscriptionEnglish: Let the knots of the heart dissolve; all things flow in the same current.

Gyatso.inscription: 云间藏笑意，慈心伴清风
Gyatso.inscriptionEnglish: Laughter rests among the clouds; a kind heart travels with the breeze.

Hakoda.inscription: 故土在心上，风浪在舟前
Hakoda.inscriptionEnglish: His homeland rests in his heart; the storm waits before his boat.

Hama.inscription: 寒牢留旧恨，月下水成缚
Hama.inscriptionEnglish: An icy prison leaves old bitterness; beneath the moon, water becomes a shackle.

Haru.inscription: 山石虽无语，少年自有声
Haru.inscriptionEnglish: Though stone is silent, the young will find their voice.

Huu.inscription: 一根连万叶，众生共此林
Huu.inscriptionEnglish: One root joins ten thousand leaves; all life belongs to this forest.

Iroh.inscription: 旧焰暖清茶，慈心照归途
Iroh.inscriptionEnglish: An old flame warms the tea; a kind heart lights the way home.

Jee.inscription: 怒海随孤舰，老兵守旧义
Jee.inscriptionEnglish: A lone ship crosses angry seas; an old soldier holds to his sense of duty.

Jeong Jeong.inscription: 烈火须知止，静水可明心
Jeong Jeong.inscriptionEnglish: Fire must learn restraint; still water may reveal the heart.

Jet.inscription: 双钩挑旧恨，林影掩少年
Jet.inscriptionEnglish: Twin hooks lift old grievances; forest shadows conceal a wounded youth.

Jin.inscription: 灯火映初笑，寻常亦动心
Jin.inscriptionEnglish: Lantern light catches a first smile; an ordinary evening can stir the heart.

Joo Dee.inscription: 笑语遮深巷，城中锁旧闻
Joo Dee.inscriptionEnglish: Polite smiles veil the narrow streets; old truths lie locked within the city.

June.inscription: 一缕旧踪迹，天涯亦可寻
June.inscriptionEnglish: Give her a trace of the past, and she will find it at the edge of the world.

Kanna.inscription: 霜雪添白发，温言守一家
Kanna.inscriptionEnglish: Snow and frost have silvered her hair; gentle words hold a family together.

Katara.inscription: 柔水承坚志，寒夜亦生光
Katara.inscriptionEnglish: Gentle water carries an unyielding will; even the coldest night may find its light.

King Bumi.inscription: 笑里藏奇策，静候石中机
King Bumi.inscriptionEnglish: A wild smile conceals a clever plan; in stillness, he waits for the moment within the stone.

King Kuei.inscription: 深宫难见世，出城始问真
King Kuei.inscriptionEnglish: The world is hard to see from a palace; beyond its walls, he begins to seek the truth.

Koh.inscription: 千面藏旧梦，无情映众生
Koh.inscriptionEnglish: A thousand faces hold old dreams; an unfeeling gaze reflects the lives of others.

Kuruk.inscription: 笑掩幽冥伤，独行护世间
Kuruk.inscriptionEnglish: A smile conceals wounds from the spirit world; alone, he walks to protect the living.

Kyoshi.inscription: 一扇分山海，寸心守公道
Kyoshi.inscriptionEnglish: One sweep of her fans divides mountain from sea; her heart holds firm to justice.

Lo and Li.inscription: 双声评烈焰，冷眼识人心
Lo and Li.inscriptionEnglish: Two voices judge the flame; cool eyes read the heart beneath it.

Long Feng.inscription: 深根缠王座，密语锁重城
Long Feng.inscriptionEnglish: Deep roots entwine the throne; whispered orders bind the walled city.

Longshot.inscription: 寡言藏远志，一箭破重围
Longshot.inscriptionEnglish: Few words conceal a steadfast purpose; one arrow breaks the encirclement.

Mai.inscription: 冷刃藏温意，沉默亦深情
Mai.inscriptionEnglish: Cold blades conceal a quiet warmth; silence, too, can hold deep affection.

Mechanist.inscription: 巧手承残翼，机心借长风
Mechanist.inscriptionEnglish: Clever hands mend broken wings; invention borrows the strength of the wind.

Meng.inscription: 青涩藏心事，一笑解旧愁
Meng.inscriptionEnglish: A young heart keeps its tender secrets; a smile begins to ease an old disappointment.

Momo.inscription: 小影穿枝叶，奇心逐云游
Momo.inscriptionEnglish: A little shadow slips through the leaves, following its curiosity beneath the clouds.

Ozai.inscription: 欲以焰吞世，终失掌中光
Ozai.inscriptionEnglish: He would swallow the world in flame, only to lose the fire in his own hands.

Pakku.inscription: 寒冰守旧法，流水终开怀
Pakku.inscriptionEnglish: Ice guards the old ways; flowing water at last opens the heart.

Piandao.inscription: 墨意入剑锋，真才越国界
Piandao.inscriptionEnglish: The spirit of ink enters the blade; true talent knows no national boundary.

Professor Zei.inscription: 黄沙埋旧路，求知不肯归
Professor Zei.inscriptionEnglish: Yellow sands bury the old road; the seeker of knowledge will not turn for home.

Roku.inscription: 故友成旧恨，余烬警后来
Roku.inscriptionEnglish: An old friendship becomes a lasting sorrow; its embers warn those who follow.

Smellerbee.inscription: 林间磨胆气，乱世守同伴
Smellerbee.inscriptionEnglish: The forest tempers her courage; in a troubled world, she stands by her companions.

Sokka.inscription: 无焰亦无惧，奇谋可补天
Sokka.inscriptionEnglish: Without flame and without fear, a clever plan can mend the sky.

Sozin.inscription: 一念图山海，百年起战尘
Sozin.inscriptionEnglish: One ambition reaches for mountains and seas; a century rises in the dust of war.

Suki.inscription: 金扇承英志，柔姿有锋芒
Suki.inscriptionEnglish: Golden fans carry a warrior's purpose; graceful movement holds a keen edge.

Teo.inscription: 双轮不缚梦，展翼向长空
Teo.inscriptionEnglish: Two wheels cannot bind his dreams; he spreads his wings toward the open sky.

The Boulder.inscription: 磐石披豪气，擂台起震声
The Boulder.inscriptionEnglish: Stone wears a mantle of bravado; the arena answers with a thunderous roar.

Toph Beifong.inscription: 闭目听山语，赤足辨尘心
Toph Beifong.inscriptionEnglish: With closed eyes she hears the mountains speak; bare feet discern the heart beneath the dust.

Ty Lee.inscription: 轻身如飞燕，笑里点风停
Ty Lee.inscriptionEnglish: Light as a darting swallow, she smiles and stills the current with a touch.

Ursa.inscription: 花影藏旧名，母心不曾远
Ursa.inscriptionEnglish: Among the flowers rests an old name; a mother's heart has never wandered far.

Wan Shi Tong.inscription: 万卷收尘世，幽馆拒兵戈
Wan Shi Tong.inscriptionEnglish: Ten thousand volumes gather the world; the shadowed library bars the weapons of war.

Xin Fu.inscription: 擂台争胜负，逐利踏尘途
Xin Fu.inscriptionEnglish: He contests victory in the arena, then follows profit down a dusty road.

Yangchen.inscription: 清风承重誓，一身系众生
Yangchen.inscriptionEnglish: A clear wind bears a solemn vow; one life is bound to the lives of all.

Yue.inscription: 以身归明月，长照海与乡
Yue.inscriptionEnglish: She gives herself to the moon, forever lighting the sea and her homeland.

Zhao.inscription: 烈焰逐虚名，怒海收狂心
Zhao.inscriptionEnglish: Flame pursues an empty glory; the angry sea claims an arrogant heart.

Zuko.inscription: 踏尽追焰路，回身见心光
Zuko.inscriptionEnglish: At the end of his pursuit of fire, he turns and finds the light within his heart.
